description: This is a Python source file that sets up and runs a conversational pipeline bot utilizing various components such as speech activity detection, language model services, and transport interfaces. It defines configurations, initializes services, constructs processing pipelines, and registers event handlers for client interactions and transcript updates.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Constructs a sequence of processing steps for the speech and text data, including input, context aggregation, transcript processing, language model invocation, and output.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with specific parameters and manages its execution lifecycle.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Manages the context for the language model, including conversation history.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates and manages the conversation context both for user and assistant roles.

classes.name: TranscriptProcessor
classes.description: Processes audio transcripts, manages transcript frames, and triggers transcript update events.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution of the processing pipeline and orchestrates event handling and shutdown.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class representing the communication transport interface.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the daily transport type.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for FastAPI WebSocket transport.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Initializes services, constructs the pipeline, and manages event handlers for a given transport.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point for starting the bot with specified runner arguments.
